zero_trace.scope: Exact piecewise-linear energy in one-dimensional component models.

trace_cover.scope: Finite component-cover inequalities and nested interval examples, not arbitrary continuum topology.

atoms.scope: Mask-closed finite dictionary for the singleton-capacity toy G; an upper approximation, not the full ellipse atomic norm.

insertion.scope: C2 piecewise-polynomial cutoff model checks second-derivative estimates; no claim to test all smooth derivatives.

gaussian.scope: Explicit uniformly local L1 models; no maximal estimate tested.

envelope.scope: Positive sums truncated to [-70,70]^2. Observed bounds are finite-model checks, not infinite-lattice certificates.

scope: Selected finite analytic mechanisms; no uniformization, Brennan, restriction or Schrodinger endpoint headline certified.
